mock_data.title: Reluctant Attendance
mock_data.passage:
Mr James was on his way to a meeting in the town hall and he was not looking forward to it. The meeting had been called by the parents of some of the children in the town to complain about the lack of playground facilities in the area. Unfortunately for Mr James, he was the councillor who had responsibility for recreation. Otherwise, wild horses would not drag him to such a meeting.

He was hoping against hope that it would be a short meeting and that he could join his wife at the party which was being held at the golf club later in the evening. It was useful to show one's face at such events and, as an estate agent, he sometimes picked up some useful business. Mr James would far rather be there than at the meeting.

However, he had a sinking feeling that the meeting would drag on and that he would not be at the party. Very likely, there would be quite a few parents in attendance and he doubted that he would be able to get rid of them very quickly. Some of the people who came to such meetings were intimidated by the fact that they were in the company of a big noise from the council and could be sent away with a few empty promises. That would not be the case tonight. He had already met some of the parents and quite a few of them had the gift of the gab and would not be content with a few excuses.

Usually, Mr James would have laid the responsibility for going to this meeting at the door of his deputy, Mr Sharp, but he had said that he was attending an important family gathering which had been arranged months ago and was unable to attend. Mr Sharp was a fairly truthful person, but on this occasion Mr James had a feeling that he was being economical with the truth.

Meeting angry parents was no picnic and all of the other councillors had claimed to be otherwise engaged when Mr James raised the subject. This was a great pity as there was always safety in numbers at such meetings. If you were unable to come up with a convincing answer, then you could always pass it on to one of your colleagues, at least until you could think of something to say.
mock_data.passageB1:
Mr. James was going to a meeting at the town hall, but he didn't want to go. The meeting was organized by parents. They wanted to talk about the lack of playgrounds for children in the town. Mr. James was the councillor in charge of things like parks and playgrounds. He really didn't want to be there.

He really hoped the meeting would be short. He wanted to go to a party with his wife at the golf club later that night. It was good to appear at these parties. As someone who sold houses (an estate agent), he sometimes got business there. Mr. James would have preferred to be at the party.

But he had a bad feeling the meeting would take a long time, and he wouldn't go to the party. He thought many parents would attend, and he wouldn't be able to finish the meeting quickly. Some people at these meetings feel shy because they are with someone important from the council. They might be happy with simple promises. But not tonight. He knew some of the parents already. Many of them were good at talking and wouldn't be happy with just excuses. They were good at expressing their ideas.

Normally, Mr. James would have asked his assistant, Mr. Sharp, to go to the meeting. But Mr. Sharp said he had an important family party that he had planned a long time ago. He couldn't go. Mr. Sharp was usually honest, but Mr. James thought he wasn't telling the whole truth this time. He felt Mr. Sharp was avoiding the meeting.

Meeting angry parents wasn't fun. All the other councillors said they were busy when Mr. James talked about the meeting. This was too bad. It's always better to have more people at these meetings. If you didn't have a good answer, you could ask a colleague to answer for you. Then you would have time to think of something to say. It's good to have support.
mock_data.passageB2:
Mr. James was on his way to the town hall for a meeting he was dreading. The meeting had been arranged by parents concerned about the lack of playground facilities in the area. As the councillor responsible for recreation, Mr. James felt obliged to attend, although he would have much preferred to be anywhere else.

He was earnestly hoping that the meeting would be brief, allowing him to join his wife at a party at the golf club later that evening. Networking at such events was beneficial, and as an estate agent, he occasionally gained valuable leads. Mr. James considered this far more appealing than the anticipated meeting.

However, he had a strong feeling that the meeting would be lengthy and prevent him from attending the party. He expected a large turnout of parents, and he doubted he could dismiss their concerns quickly. While some people at such meetings might be intimidated by a council official and easily satisfied with vague promises, he knew this wouldn't be the case tonight. He had already met some of the parents, and many were articulate and wouldn't accept simple excuses.

Normally, Mr. James would have delegated the responsibility of attending this meeting to his deputy, Mr. Sharp. However, Mr. Sharp claimed to be attending an important family event planned months in advance and was unable to be there. While Mr. Sharp was generally honest, Mr. James suspected he was being less than truthful on this occasion.

Facing a group of angry parents was far from ideal, and all the other councillors had claimed prior engagements when Mr. James mentioned the meeting. This was unfortunate, as there was always strength in numbers at such gatherings. If one councillor couldn't provide a convincing answer, they could pass the buck to a colleague, at least until they could formulate a response.
mock_data.passageC1:
Mr. James was en route to a town hall meeting, an engagement he approached with considerable trepidation. The assembly had been convened at the behest of parents voicing grievances regarding the paucity of playground facilities within the locality. As the councillor directly responsible for recreation, Mr. James found himself, much to his chagrin, bearing the brunt of their discontent; under any other circumstances, he would have gone to great lengths to avoid such a confrontation.

He harbored a faint hope that the proceedings would be expeditious, allowing him to join his wife at the golf club's evening soiree. Such gatherings, while often tedious, served as valuable opportunities for networking, and, as a property professional, he occasionally managed to drum up valuable business. Mr. James would infinitely have preferred the convivial atmosphere of the club to the potentially acrimonious environment that awaited him.

A nagging premonition, however, suggested that the meeting would be protracted, effectively precluding his attendance at the party. He anticipated a significant parental turnout and doubted his ability to placate them swiftly. While some individuals in such situations might be intimidated by the presence of a council official, and thus susceptible to appeasement through insincere assurances, Mr. James recognised that this would not be the case tonight. Having previously encountered some of the parents, he knew that a considerable number possessed the gift of the gab and would not be easily dismissed with empty platitudes.

Ordinarily, Mr. James would have delegated responsibility for attending this meeting to his deputy, Mr. Sharp. However, Mr. Sharp had cited a long-standing family commitment as precluding his availability. While generally a man of integrity, Mr. James suspected that Mr. Sharp's explanation was, to put it mildly, a convenient untruth, designed to shirk an unpleasant duty.

Facing an assembly of disgruntled parents was far from appealing, and all other councillors had conveniently declared themselves unavailable when Mr. James raised the matter. This was particularly regrettable, as there was invariably strength in numbers in such scenarios. Should one find oneself unable to formulate a convincing response, the onus could be passed on to a colleague, at least until a more palatable explanation could be devised. Mr. James knew he would have to bite the bullet and face the music alone.

questions.answer: Answers may vary. Examples: What was the meeting about? Why was Mr James reluctant? Did he attend the meeting? What happened at the meeting? Did he make it to the party? How did the parents react?
questions.question: Ask one question that you want answered after reading the passage.

questions.answer: Answers may vary. Reasons include: expecting confrontation or complaints, having other plans/commitments, anticipating it will be boring or long, feeling unprepared, not wanting to take responsibility, disliking the topic, anxiety about public speaking, knowing it will be difficult or uncomfortable.
questions.question: Why do you think someone would be reluctant to attend a meeting?

questions.answer: Answers may vary. Students should describe: the event/meeting they didn't want to attend, why they were reluctant (conflicting plans, anxiety, disinterest, etc.), whether they attended anyway, and what the outcome was.
questions.question: Talk about a time when you were reluctant to attend a meeting or similar event.

Janob Jeyms shahar hokimligida yig'ilishga ketayotgan edi va u bunga intiqlik bilan qaramayotgan edi. Yig'ilish shahardagi ba'zi bolalarning ota-onalari tomonidan hududdagi o'yin maydonchalarining etishmasligi haqida shikoyat qilish uchun chaqirilgan edi. Afsuski janob Jeyms uchun, u dam olish uchun mas'ul bo'lgan kengash a'zosi edi. Aks holda, yovvoyi otlar ham uni bunday yig'ilishga sudrab kela olmaydi.

U qisqa yig'ilish bo'lishiga va kechqurun keyinroq golf klubida bo'ladigan ziyofatga xotini bilan qo'shilishga umidsizlik bilan umid qilardi. Bunday tadbirlarda yuzini ko'rsatish foydali edi va ko'chmas mulk agenti sifatida u ba'zan foydali biznes topib olardi. Janob Jeyms yig'ilishda bo'lishdan ko'ra u yerda bo'lishni afzal ko'rardi.

Biroq, uning yig'ilish cho'zilib ketishi va ziyofatda bo'lolmasligi haqida tushkunlik hissi bor edi. Juda ehtimol, bir nechta ota-onalar qatnashadi va u ulardan tez qutilishi mumkin emasligiga shubha qilardi. Bunday yig'ilishlarga kelgan ba'zi odamlar kengashning katta kishisi oldida ekanliklaridan qo'rqib ketishardi va bir nechta bo'sh va'dalar bilan yuborilishi mumkin edi. Bu kecha bunday bo'lmaydi. U allaqachon ba'zi ota-onalar bilan uchrashgan va ularning ko'pchiligi so'z iste'dodiga ega edilar va bir nechta bahonalar bilan qanoatlanmaydilar.

Odatda, janob Jeyms bu yig'ilishga borish mas'uliyatini o'rinbosari janob Sharp eshigiga qo'ygan bo'lardi, ammo u oylar oldin rejalashtirilgan muhim oilaviy yig'ilishda qatnashayotganini va kela olmasligini aytdi. Janob Sharp juda to'g'ri odam edi, ammo bu safar janob Jeymsda u haqiqatga tejamkor munosabatda bo'layotgani haqida tuyg'u bor edi.

G'azablangan ota-onalar bilan uchrashish sayr emas edi va janob Jeyms mavzuni ko'targanda boshqa barcha kengash a'zolari boshqa band ekanliklarini da'vo qilishgan. Bu juda achinarli edi, chunki bunday yig'ilishlarda har doim ommada xavfsizlik bor edi. Agar siz ishonchli javob topa olmasangiz, unda siz har doim uni hamkasblaringizdan biriga topshira olasiz, hech bo'lmaganda nimadir aytishni o'ylab topguncha.

mock_data.translationB1:
Janob Jeyms shahar hokimiyatida bo'ladigan yig'ilishga borishi kerak edi, lekin u borishni xohlamasdi. Yig'ilishni ota-onalar tashkil qilgan edi. Ular shaharda bolalar uchun o'yingohlar yetishmasligi haqida gaplashmoqchi edilar. Janob Jeyms bog'lar va o'yingohlar kabi narsalar uchun mas'ul bo'lgan deputat edi. U yerda bo'lishni umuman xohlamasdi.

U yig'ilish qisqa bo'lishiga umid qilgan edi. U o'sha kechqurun rafiqasi bilan golf klubidagi ziyofatga borishni xohlardi. Bunday ziyofatlarda ko'rinish berish yaxshi edi. Uy sotuvchisi (rieltor) sifatida u ba'zan u yerda biznes qilardi. Janob Jeyms ziyofatda bo'lishni afzal ko'rardi.

Lekin uning ko'nglida yig'ilish uzoq davom etishi va u ziyofatga bora olmasligi haqida yomon tuyg'u bor edi. Uning fikricha, ko'plab ota-onalar qatnashadi va u yig'ilishni tezda tugata olmaydi. Bunday yig'ilishlardagi ba'zi odamlar kengashdan muhim bir kishi bilan birga bo'lgani uchun uyalishadi. Ular oddiy va'dalar bilan ham xursand bo'lishlari mumkin. Lekin bu kecha emas. U ota-onalarning ba'zilarini allaqachon bilardi. Ularning ko'pchiligi gapirishga usta edi va faqat bahonalar bilan xursand bo'lmasdi. Ular o'z fikrlarini bildirishga usta edilar.

Odatda, Janob Jeyms yig'ilishga o'zining yordamchisi janob Sharpni yuborishni so'ragan bo'lardi. Lekin janob Sharp uzoq vaqt oldin rejalashtirilgan muhim oilaviy ziyofati borligini aytdi. U bora olmasdi. Janob Sharp odatda rostgo'y edi, lekin Janob Jeyms uning bu safar to'liq rost gapirmayotganini o'yladi. U janob Sharp yig'ilishdan qochayotganini his qildi.

G'azablangan ota-onalar bilan uchrashish qiziqarli emas edi. Janob Jeyms yig'ilish haqida gapirganda, boshqa barcha deputatlar band ekanliklarini aytishdi. Bu juda yomon edi. Bunday yig'ilishlarda ko'proq odam bo'lishi har doim yaxshiroq. Agar sizda yaxshi javob bo'lmasa, hamkasbingizdan siz uchun javob berishini so'rashingiz mumkin. Keyin sizda nimadir deyish haqida o'ylashga vaqt bo'ladi. Qo'llab-quvvatlashga ega bo'lish yaxshi.
mock_data.translationB2:
Janob Jeyms shahar hokimiyatiga o'zi qo'rqinchli deb bilgan yig'ilishga ketayotgan edi. Yig'ilish hududdagi o'yin maydonchalari yetishmasligidan xavotirda bo'lgan ota-onalar tomonidan tashkillashtirilgan edi. Dam olish uchun mas'ul bo'lgan kengash a'zosi sifatida janob Jeyms qatnashishga majbur ekanligini his qildi, garchi u boshqa joyda bo'lishni afzal ko'rgan bo'lardi.

U yig'ilish qisqa bo'lishiga, o'sha oqshom golf klubidagi ziyofatda xotini bilan birga bo'lishga imkon berishiga chin dildan umid qilardi. Bunday tadbirlarda aloqa o'rnatish foydali edi va ko'chmas mulk agenti sifatida u ba'zan qimmatli imkoniyatlarga ega bo'lardi. Janob Jeyms buni kutilayotgan yig'ilishdan ko'ra ancha yoqimli deb hisobladi.

Biroq, uning kuchli tuyg'usi yig'ilish uzoq davom etishi va unga ziyofatga borishga to'sqinlik qilishi edi. U ota-onalarning ko'plab kelishini kutgan va ularning xavotirlarini tezda rad etishiga shubha qilgan. Bunday yig'ilishlardagi ba'zi odamlar kengash rasmiysi tomonidan qo'rqitilishi va aniq bo'lmagan va'dalar bilan osonlikcha qanoatlanishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, u bu oqshom bunday bo'lmasligini bilar edi. U allaqachon ota-onalarning ba'zilari bilan uchrashgan va ularning ko'pchiligi ravon nutqli edi va oddiy bahonalarni qabul qilmasdi.

Odatda, janob Jeyms bu yig'ilishda qatnashish mas'uliyatini o'zining o'rinbosari janob Sharpga yuklagan bo'lardi. Biroq, janob Sharp bir necha oy oldin rejalashtirilgan muhim oilaviy tadbirda qatnashayotganini va u erda bo'la olmasligini ta'kidladi. Janob Sharp odatda halol bo'lsa-da, janob Jeyms bu safar u kamroq rostgo'y bo'lgan deb gumon qildi.

G'azablangan ota-onalar guruhi bilan yuzma-yuz kelishish umuman yaxshi emas edi va janob Jeyms yig'ilish haqida gapirganda, boshqa barcha kengash a'zolari oldindan rejalashtirilgan tadbirlari borligini aytishdi. Bu afsuski, bunday yig'inlarda har doim son jihatdan ustunlik bor edi. Agar bir kengash a'zosi ishonchli javob bera olmasa, ular hech bo'lmaganda javobni shakllantirguncha, mas'uliyatni hamkasbiga o'tkazishi mumkin edi.
mock_data.translationC1:
Janob Jeyms shahar hokimligining yig'ilishiga yo'l olayotgan edi, bu uchrashuvga u katta qo'rquv bilan yondashdi. Yig'ilish ota-onalarning mahalladagi o'yin maydonchalari yetishmasligidan shikoyat qilishi ortidan chaqirilgan edi. Dam olish sohasiga bevosita mas'ul bo'lgan kengash a'zosi sifatida janob Jeyms, afsuski, ularning noroziligini o'z zimmasiga oldi; boshqa har qanday sharoitda u bunday to'qnashuvdan qochish uchun hamma narsaga tayyor bo'lardi.

U yig'ilish tez o'tishiga va xotini bilan golf klubining kechki ziyofatiga qo'shilishiga umid qilardi. Bunday yig'ilishlar ko'pincha zerikarli bo'lsa-da, aloqa o'rnatish uchun qimmatli imkoniyat bo'lib xizmat qiladi va ko'chmas mulk mutaxassisi sifatida u vaqti-vaqti bilan qimmatli biznes topishga muvaffaq bo'lardi. Janob Jeyms klubning do'stona muhitini uni kutayotgan potentsial dushmanlik muhitidan ming marta afzal ko'rardi.

Ammo, bezovta qiluvchi xavotirlik uchrashuvning cho'zilishini va uning ziyofatga borishiga to'sqinlik qilishini ko'rsatardi. U ota-onalarning ko'pchiligi kelishini kutgan va ularni tezda tinchlantirishga qodir ekanligiga shubha qilgan. Bunday vaziyatlarda ba'zi odamlar kengash rasmiysining mavjudligidan qo'rqib, samimiy bo'lmagan va'dalar bilan tinchlantirilishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, janob Jeyms bu kecha bunday bo'lmasligini tushundi. Ilgari ota-onalarning ba'zilari bilan uchrashgan holda, u ularning ko'pchiligi gapga chechan ekanligini va ularni bo'sh gaplar bilan osonlikcha rad etib bo'lmasligini bilardi.

Odatda, janob Jeyms ushbu yig'ilishda qatnashish mas'uliyatini o'zining o'rinbosari janob Sharpga yuklagan bo'lardi. Biroq, janob Sharp uzoq yillik oilaviy majburiyati borligini aytib, o'zining mavjud emasligini bildirdi. Umuman olganda, vijdonli odam bo'lgan janob Jeyms janob Sharpning tushuntirishi, yumshoq qilib aytganda, yoqimsiz vazifadan qochish uchun mo'ljallangan qulay yolg'on ekanligiga shubha qildi.

Norozilik bildirayotgan ota-onalar yig'ilishi unchalik yoqimli emas edi va janob Jeyms bu masalani ko'targanida, barcha boshqa kengash a'zolari o'zlarini mavjud emas deb e'lon qilishdi. Bu ayniqsa afsuslanarli edi, chunki bunday stsenariylarda doimo ko'pchilikda kuch bor. Agar kimdir ishonchli javob berishga qodir bo'lmasa, mas'uliyatni hamkasbga o'tkazish mumkin edi, hech bo'lmaganda yanada maqbul tushuntirish o'ylab topilmaguncha. Janob Jeyms chidam kerakligini va yakka o'zi javob berishini bilardi.
